Kimberly / Samantha — jumping in from procurement.

We have a formalized small-vendor allowance that we can apply to Bridge Finance under these conditions: 
1) Pilot monthly run-rate <= $10,000 USD;
2) Vendor provides W9 (or equivalent) + 1 reference invoice OR 2 trade references;
3) No storage of Redwood customer PII within vendor systems OR a data-processing addendum (DPA) in place;
4) Signed short-form payment terms (standard 30 net) and confirmation that invoices will be emailed to accounts@redwood.com;
5) Procurement and Finance reserve right to revoke the allowlist if risk indicators surface.

If the conditions are met we grant a 60-day temporary PO exemption and tag invoices with an "INV-ONLY-PILOT" routing so AR can process without a PO. For pilots expected to exceed $10k/month we require either a PO or a pre-funded credit arrangement.

Please ask the vendor to send the expected pilot spend and answers to the bullets Kimberly requested. Procurement will then create PROC ticket and route to Finance for final sign-off.

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
